name: terminal
description:
Ejecución profesional de comandos, scripts interactivos, sesiones persistentes con gestión de entorno, tareas background y control de procesos del sistema.
Acciones e inputs de exactos: attach_session { sessionId } | close_session { sessionId } | create_session { sessionId, cwd, env } | get_background_output { taskId, pid, tailLines } | kill_background_task { taskId, pid } | kill_process { pid } | kill_process_tree { pid } | list_background_tasks {} | list_processes { filterName, limit, sortBy } | list_sessions { id, cwd, createdAt, updatedAt, historyCount, envKeysCount } | open_file_explorer { path } | open_url { url } | run_as_admin { command, cwd } | run_background { command, cwd } | run_command { command, timeout, cwd, env, shell, stripAnsi, maxOutputChars } | run_inline_script { code, language, args, cwd, timeout, stripAnsi } | run_script { path, args, interpreter, cwd, env, timeout, stripAnsi, maxOutputChars } | run_session_command { sessionId, command, cwd, env } | stop_background_task { taskId, pid } | wait_for_background_task { taskId, pid, timeoutMs, pollIntervalMs }
